summary: First full frontend test of 'Nek Sathi' Expo app integrated with the live production backend at https://neksathi-live.emergent.host/api. Verified via mobile viewport (390x844) the Expo web preview at EXPO_PACKAGER_PROXY_URL. Core auth (login, register-render+validation, forgot-password submit), token persistence on reload, logout, and all major CRUD/navigation flows work end-to-end against the live backend: SOS open+cancel, Emergency Contacts add+delete-visible, SOS History, Live Location start+active+stop, Safe Zones add+visible, Family (member view + invite code copy), Vehicles add (BA12PA3456 visible after save), Alerts feed loads, Profile tab + notification prefs + edit-profile + logout, and Theft Protection (already-enrolled path shows Lock/Siren/SIM controls). Only web-preview limitations observed (map placeholder, camera prompts) which are expected native-only features. No red-screen errors. No deprecated Expo packages (expo-av/expo-barcode-scanner/expo-background-fetch). Some console warnings from RN Web are cosmetic. High confidence the app integrates correctly with the live backend.

issues: Console: 'shadow*' style props are deprecated on web — cosmetic; consider migrating to boxShadow for cleaner web logs, but shadow works on native. Non-blocking.

react_native_issues.issue: Warning: 'Listening to push token changes is not yet fully supported on web' — expected on web preview; verify on native build. Reference: /app/frontend/src/lib/push.ts

Console error: 'Accessing element.ref was removed in React 19' triggered from a UI library while opening Family tab. Cosmetic on web but should be tracked; likely from a nested component using element.ref. Non-blocking.

action_items: Optional: migrate remaining 'shadow*' style props to 'boxShadow' (web-only warning). Non-blocking.
Optional: audit any custom component that reads element.ref (React 19 no longer supports it). Non-blocking on web preview.

Verify native-only flows on a physical device / dev build: QR /scan camera, /sos-video recording, /crash-detection accelerometer, react-native-maps rendering, intruder selfie & SIM-swap detection (documented in Theft Protection footer).
critical_code_review_comments: api.ts correctly uses EXPO_PUBLIC_API_URL from env and JWT bearer via expo-secure-store — matches spec.
AuthContext bootstrap does GET /auth/me and clears bad tokens — proper token-persistence flow, confirmed by reload test.
All interactive elements have proper testID props matching the spec (login-*, register-*, forgot-*, bento-*, contact-*, zone-*, live-*, vehicle-*, family-*, tab-*, profile-*, theft-*).
